CHAPTER.CAPTION: A Psalm of David.
CHAPTER.VERS: The earth is Jehovahs, and the fullness of it; the world, and those who dwell in it.
For He has founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the rivers.
Who shall go up into the hill of Jehovah? Or who shall stand in His holy place?
He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
He shall receive the blessing from Jehovah, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
This is the generation of Jacob of those who seek Him, who seek Your face. Selah.
Lift up your heads, O you gates! And be lifted up, you everlasting doors! And the King of Glory shall come in.
Who is this King of Glory? Jehovah strong and mighty, Jehovah mighty in battle.
Lift up your heads, O you gates! Lift up, you everlasting doors! And the King of Glory shall come in.
Who is this King of Glory? Jehovah of Hosts, He is the King of Glory. Selah.
